name: Bite Me
source:
The party you attended has turned deadly, and now you must seduce vampires to stay alive… but you’re also becoming one of them.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你參加的派對成了一場致命的聚會。為了活下去，你必須引誘那些吸血鬼……可你自己也在變成它們中的一員。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
